post.title: The euro hit a 17-month low. Here's what it does to you
post.ig:
The euro hit a 17-month low against the dollar overnight.
It touched $1.1161 in Asian trading on Oct 5, 2026, its weakest since May 2025, as France's debt worries and Spain's snap election (Nov 29) rattled markets.
Example: EUR 2,000 of trip spending is about $2,240 at $1.12, roughly $125 less than at February 2026's average rate.
Flip side: stocks priced in euros convert into fewer dollars.
Sources: Bloomberg, Euronews, CNBC (Oct 5, 2026); Federal Reserve G.5 exchange-rate data.
